analysis: SFMC-REQ-001 specifies a clear functional behavior required of the SFMC software to display the spacecraft's current position to the pilot. It contains no vague criteria, escape clauses, or unassigned allocations. Furthermore, displaying position is a standard navigation/display capability rather than a specific safety control or mitigation, so no SWE-184 link applies.
summary: SFMC-REQ-001 clearly specifies a mandatory software display function without ambiguity or quality defects.
